label: FIXTURE RESULT: Stage 5 evaluation (recorded window, frozen bundle)

attempts.validity: all complete True, pending max 4.0, failures 0, server errors 0.0, pool timeouts 0, other edges 0

A.rule: no failed deliveries and pending stayed low

report.summary: Delivery in the window is healthy and keeps pace with arrivals. A stale backlog (296 FAILED rows, oldest undelivered ~10 h) predates the window; its cause is not visible.

findings.claim: In-window outbox keeps up: 660 arrivals, 660 publications, a brief burst to 38/10s was absorbed with no lag.
findings.reason: Arrivals minus publications is 0 and settled; per-bucket publications track arrivals.

findings.claim: In-window delivery attempts all succeed and are fast (~71 ms p50, 80 ms max), dominated by consumer auth time.
findings.reason: 660/660 SUCCESS, no errors; latency far below the 3000 ms timeout.

findings.claim: A static backlog exists: 296 FAILED rows unchanged and oldest undelivered age ~36,000 s, growing 1:1 with time.
findings.reason: Failed count is constant at 296 and age rises with wall clock, so these rows are stuck, not being retried or delivered.

limitations: Window is 4 minutes; the original failures that produced the 296 FAILED rows happened outside it and no failure logs are covered.
Cannot tell whether customers' late notifications map to the stuck backlog or to an earlier period.
next_checks: Inspect the 296 FAILED outbox rows: failure reasons, timestamps and attempt counts (maxAttempts=8), and whether they are eligible for retry.
Review delivery logs and consumer availability from ~10 h before the window, when the oldest undelivered row was created.

alternatives.reason: No acquisition timeouts or pending borrowers; no blocking sessions sampled.
alternatives.hypothesis: DB pool exhaustion or lock contention delaying outbox work

alternatives.reason: Transfers p99 0.25 s with no 5xx; consumer handling is about 0.015 ms.
alternatives.hypothesis: Slow consumer or transfer API latency causing late notifications
